methodology.timing: perf_counter around train_bpe only; median of alternating-order runs
methodology.warmup: Both trainers run once on the small corpus; each input is hashed before timing
methodology.profile: Separate cProfile runs, both single process; profiler overhead is not production speedup
methodology.parallel: Four-worker wall time only; parent cProfile would omit child-process work
methodology.equality: Exact vocabulary dictionary and ordered merge list comparison after every measured call
